name: closeSetup
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('setupDialog'); if (d && d.open) d.close(); return 'ok'; })()

name: times
js: (() => { const t = GMMCJourney.times('union','peak'); const v = Object.values(t); return JSON.stringify({reached: v.length, stations: Object.keys(GMMC.getMap().stations).length, max: Math.max(...v), union: t.union}); })()

name: ui
js: (() => { document.getElementById('jyToggle').click(); const f = document.getElementById('jyFrom'), t = document.getElementById('jyTo'); f.value = 'Finch'; f.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); t.value = 'Unionville'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); return document.getElementById('jyResult').innerText.slice(0, 300); })()

name: svg export
js: (() => { const s = GMMC.standaloneSvg ? GMMC.standaloneSvg() : ''; return [typeof s, String(s).length, String(s).includes('jy-export-legend')]; })()
